_notes: Fenris Isle + Shadowpine Altar boss/rare loot (2026-10-23). ONE item per kill from the pool; ilvl = creature level + 3.

Ancient Curse-Beast.name: Curse-Beast Hide Jerkin
Ancient Curse-Beast.flavor_text: Matted, stitched with its own sinew, and still faintly warm.

Ancient Curse-Beast.name: Ironclaw of the Isle
Ancient Curse-Beast.flavor_text: A claw the length of a forearm, bound to a bone grip.

Ancient Curse-Beast.name: Rotted Heartstone Pendant
Ancient Curse-Beast.flavor_text: Something that was once a heart, calcified and heavy.

Ancient Curse-Beast.name: Cursed Fang Greaves
Ancient Curse-Beast.flavor_text: Plate studded with fangs. Not all of them were the beast's.

Baron Ashbury.name: Baron's Signet of Fenris
Baron Ashbury.flavor_text: The family seal, worn thin by a hand that would not let go.

Baron Ashbury.name: Ashbury's Gilded Rapier
Baron Ashbury.flavor_text: A duelling blade for a man who never lost a duel and never forgave one.

Baron Ashbury.name: Mouldering Manor Cloak
Baron Ashbury.flavor_text: Velvet gone to moss. It still hangs with great dignity.

Baron Ashbury.name: Footman's Last Orders Mail
Baron Ashbury.flavor_text: Mail issued to a house guard who was never relieved.

Captain's Ghost.name: Drowned Captain's Cutlass
Captain's Ghost.flavor_text: Salt-pitted but wickedly sharp. It drips on dry decks.

Captain's Ghost.name: Barnacled Tricorn
Captain's Ghost.flavor_text: Crusted with shells, with a fish somehow still living in the brim.

Captain's Ghost.name: Spectral Logbook Charm
Captain's Ghost.flavor_text: The last entry reads only: the water is inside the ship.

Captain's Ghost.name: Harpooner's Brine Gloves
Captain's Ghost.flavor_text: Waxed leather, stiff with salt and old blood.

The Alpha Cur.name: Alpha's Gnawed Bone Club
The Alpha Cur.flavor_text: A thighbone worked into a club. Every notch is a tooth-mark.

The Alpha Cur.name: Packmaster's Studded Collar
The Alpha Cur.flavor_text: A heavy collar. Some dog was very, very good.

The Alpha Cur.name: Cur-Hide Leggings
The Alpha Cur.flavor_text: Patchwork of ten different pelts, all of them snarling.

The Alpha Cur.name: Howling Skull Mantle
The Alpha Cur.flavor_text: A skull on each shoulder. They howl in a stiff wind.

Bonewarden Aldric.name: Aldric's Femur Hammer
Bonewarden Aldric.flavor_text: Two-handed, ugly, and entirely made of someone's leg.

Bonewarden Aldric.name: Bone-Ward Pauldrons
Bonewarden Aldric.flavor_text: Overlapping plates of knitted rib. They knock when you walk.

Bonewarden Aldric.name: Ritual Knucklebone Ring
Bonewarden Aldric.flavor_text: A ring of finger-bone, with a stone that watches.

Bonewarden Aldric.name: Wardens' Shroud Belt
Bonewarden Aldric.flavor_text: Burial linen, bound with knotted hair.

Curse Keeper Tael.name: Tael's Moonlit Scepter
Curse Keeper Tael.flavor_text: A silver rod tipped with a glass moon. It's never quite full.

Curse Keeper Tael.name: Keeper's Hexed Vestments
Curse Keeper Tael.flavor_text: Robes cut so that every fold hides a smaller curse.

Curse Keeper Tael.name: Curse-Breaker's Bracers
Curse Keeper Tael.flavor_text: Silvered leather bracers; they warm against a hex.

Curse Keeper Tael.name: Pendant of the Last Rite
Curse Keeper Tael.flavor_text: A small wooden holy symbol. It has been reused too many times.

Curse Keeper Tael.name: Fenris Confessional Record
Curse Keeper Tael.flavor_text: The confessor's side is blank throughout.
Curse Keeper Tael.label: Tome (Int/Spi)

Alpha Fenris.name: Fenris' Cursed Fang
Alpha Fenris.flavor_text: A fang the length of a short sword, still wet at the root.

Alpha Fenris.name: Alpha's Moonhide Hauberk
Alpha Fenris.flavor_text: Silver-grey hide that shifts colour in moonlight.

Alpha Fenris.name: Greaves of the Howling Dark
Alpha Fenris.flavor_text: Plate boots with claw-marks cut deep down both shins.

Alpha Fenris.name: Moonbound Curse-Ring
Alpha Fenris.flavor_text: A band that tightens each full moon and loosens after. It is a patient ring.
